title: My Favorite Husband
paragraphs: Lucille Ball and Richard Denning star as Liz and George Cooper in a domestic situation comedy about marriage, neighbors, misunderstandings, and everyday life.

Domestic situation comedy starring Lucille Ball and Richard Denning. The early Cugat identity evolved into Liz and George Cooper; later ensemble includes Rudolph and Iris Atterbury. Frozen GRH coverage runs August 6, 1948 through March 24, 1951.
GRH documents the program through CBS weekly radio run (July 23, 1948 to March 31, 1951) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Lucille Ball (performer on 60 recordings), Richard Denning (performer on 60 recordings), Isabel Scott Rorick (creator on 58 recordings and writer on 1 recording), [[person|gale-gordon|Gale Gordon]] (performer on 41 recordings), Hans Conried (performer on 24 recordings), Ruth Perrott (performer on 23 recordings), and Frank Nelson (performer on 22 recordings).

The program is also connected in the archive to [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] (broadcast on network), [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]] (rebroadcast by), and [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]] (rebroadcast by).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include jealousy and romantic misunderstanding, domestic household life, marriage and couple relationships, social status and clubs, household money and spending, and workplace and boss relationships.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including Cugat-to-Cooper middle-class refocus, Atterbury ensemble expansion, and Production bridge to I Love Lucy.

Programs with especially strong personnel connections in the GRH knowledge graph include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]] (34 shared credited people), [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]] (31 shared credited people), [[show|the-railroad-hour|The Railroad Hour]] (27 shared credited people), [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]] (29 shared credited people), and [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]] (26 shared credited people).
